string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Search finds your phone\'s settings: Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, Display, Battery, Do Not Disturb and about 50 more. Type what you\'re after, like \"brightness\" or \"hotspot\", and tap to go straight to that screen. Only screens your phone can really open are listed.
Any word of a name answers straight away, so \"music\" finds \"YT Music\" without waiting for the rest of the search.
Apps that change their icon, such as for a festival, open again when tapped instead of saying \"no app found\".
Search for \"launcher settings\" to open HALauncher\'s own settings.
The empty search field suggests something different to try each time it opens.
